headline: [Preview of Edaily Newspaper] "Trump Neglects U.S. Deficit, Shaking Korean Exports and Interest Rates Too"
summary: Edaily's front page carries a report that U.S. deficit policy could shake Korean exports and interest rates. The input provides no further detail on the mechanism or magnitude.
why: South Korea is an export-driven economy, so U.S. demand and trade policy matter for its growth. Interest rates in Korea are influenced by global rate expectations and capital flows.
